title: Spinach & Feta Omlette
method: Handful spinach - use minimum 50 - 80 grams to add good nutrient value
caption:
Spinach & Feta Omlette
under 300 calorie | 10 minute breakfasts 

If you have any questions about the recipe or how to execute it, drop a comment and i will respond to help you out <3 

Nutrition: 
C: 5 | F: 14 | P: 16
Calories: 209 per serve (without bread)
Serves 1

Ingredients
2 eggs (2 grams)
knobb of butter
1 tsp minced garlic 
handful spinach - use minimum 50 - 80 grams to add good nutrient value
salt + pepper, to taste
10 grams feta
handful coriander to garnish
 
serve with sourdough bread
